summary: Frame a learning task as a small inviting experiment with one clear manipulable object and visible consequences.
objective: A learner can identify the control, observe its effect and recover the starting state; decorative light does not impersonate a computed result.
intent_signals: Set the scene in a playful learning laboratory
Use playful science lab as the narrative setting
example_prompts: Build a playful full-adder lab where large switches drive real input bits and the carry output remains clear.

principles: Frame a learning task as a small inviting experiment with one clear manipulable object and visible consequences.
Theme supplies setting and motifs; choose geometry style, rendering approach and factual model independently.
implementation: Use large handles, distinct modules and a contained experiment area; decorative props should not resemble active controls.
Choose separated accent colors for controls and state, with neutral surfaces around the experiment and broad readable lighting.
Keep a stable teaching view and offer inspection on demand; animate transitions from the actual model and provide pause, step or reset as relevant.
observable_checks: A learner can identify the control, observe its effect and recover the starting state; decorative light does not impersonate a computed result.
Inspect one focal object close up and the complete route or spatial relationship from an overview.

known_limits: Authored fictional setting guidance; no rendered artifact or runtime improvement has been observed for this record.
This proposal does not establish historical, cultural, scientific or engineering facts.
creative_affordances: Combine with toy-miniature or cartoon style; playful treatment preserves equations, units, truth tables and domain invariants.
Replace motifs or combine settings to suit the user brief; maintain a readable organizing idea rather than treating these suggestions as a fixed asset list.
